FRONTIER RESEARCH — 7 OCTOBER 2026
Local research checkpoint. Substantially language-model-assisted; not externally reviewed.

STATUS
No field-breaking result or priority claim is certified. This run has produced
complete internal derivations, conditional algorithmic consequences, exact
counterexamples, executable acquisition code, and independent adversarial audits.
Finite diagnostics are separated from proofs and from unimplemented algorithms.
The original breakthrough objective remains open.

The strongest current cluster connects log-concave counting to quantum many-body
simulation and rare-state preparation. A separate critical-spin construction
removes entangling gates from a previously proposed operational decoder. These
are stronger outcomes than the initial field survey, but their novelty and
external correctness still require specialist assessment.

PRIOR CAPITAL AND SEARCH
Read Astra 00_START_HERE.txt and 01_CORE.txt first. The pinned repository is
https://github.com/harjassand/astra-research-knowledge
commit 2973135d6219c63137ced287df791e385b737816 (including S update).
Retrieved relevant cards, decisive proofs, reported failures and newer packages
selectively. The live OpenAI mathematics repository remained at Astra's pinned
adc7f1241b42e322a6451854ab7e4b4c146bf78a snapshot; no newer commit was found.

Initial independent attacks covered quantum information, energy detection,
fermions, photons, statistical experiments, reactions, learning, algebraic
complexity, optimization, many-body physics, PDE, groups, combinatorics/codes,
arithmetic, Hamiltonian complexity, materials and causal inference. Depth led to
new searches in Lorentzian polynomial theory, interlacing characteristic
polynomials, stochastic local filters, no-broadcasting monogamy, and numerical
acquisition. Later waves attacked consequences and independently checked gates.
Subagents were requested as GPT-6.1 Sol at maximum reasoning effort.

NEW FRONTIER / RESUME WITHOUT REPEATING THE SURVEY
7 October 2026. Internal research; not externally reviewed.

The campaign has not established a field-breaking result. Two sharper open
mechanisms now sit beyond the verified internal transfers. Begin here, then
read their exact latest reports; do not silently strengthen imported results.

1. DETERMINANT-WEIGHTED LINEAR MATROID PARITY

For explicit complex rational F in C^(n x n), let
 c_k(F)=sum_{I,J disjoint, |I|=|J|=k} |det F[I,J]|^2.
This is the k-pair norm of a hard onsite-projected opposite-spin BCS state.
With f_i equal to the transpose of row i, V=[I,F^T], and P(I) selecting both
columns (e_i,f_i), Cauchy--Binet gives
 c_k(F)=sum_{|I|=k} det((V*V)[P(I)]).
Equivalently retain only exponents 0 or 2 in
 det(I+sum_i x_i(e_i e_i*+f_i f_i*)), then replace x_i^2 by z_i.

The scalar sum_k c_k z^k is real-rooted by the audited clone identity.
Support, exact zero detection and witnesses also have a deterministic
polynomial-bit reduction to the imported Hamada--Iwata unweighted linear
matroid-parity algorithm. Clear rational-complex denominators, bound the norm
of a nonzero Gaussian-integer minor, and test polynomially many finite fields;
one preserves an optimum witness and all modular witnesses lift soundly.
Forced-pair contraction and excluded-pair deletion handle prefixes. The
algorithmic import and reduction have not been implemented here. The earlier
randomized Pfaffian route remains valid. Neither supplies a counting oracle.

New target: a polynomial-bit relative norm/coefficient algorithm and acquired
conditional samples for this exact weighted parity class. An appropriate
worm/defect representation would extend conditional hard-projected-state
preparation beyond the bipartite pair-matrix subclass. All oracle, support,
coefficient range, balancing, precision and sample costs must be charged.
